protocol.preprocessing: full undirected ogbn-arxiv; StandardScaler fitted on official training nodes, shared saved tensors
protocol.precision: float32; both CGC reconstruction solves float64, ridge=0; TF32 disabled
protocol.cgc: rate-specific package parameters; spectral clustering; FAISS/sklearn both 10 restarts, 300 iterations
protocol.clustgdd: rate-specific propagation/alpha/loss settings; 600 MLP pretraining and 100 refinement updates, hidden256, 2 post-propagation steps; both MiniBatchKMeans n_init3, max_iter100, batch_size1000
adapters: shared inputs/splits/output contract instead of repository loaders
CGC confidence masks copied to CPU for its CPU confidence tensors; native CPU clustering and GPU aggregation retained
CGC reconstruction precision harmonized to float64
ClustGDD MiniBatchKMeans restart budget harmonized; integer IDs passed into native compression
protocol.timing: wall time with CUDA synchronization around entire in-memory reduction, including preprocessing/transfers; excludes imports, data loading, graph serialization, and downstream evaluation
protocol.memory: fresh process; process RSS sampled every5ms; PyTorch peak GPU allocated/reserved reset after context warmup, before input transfers; excludes downstream evaluation
protocol.quality: one shared GCN fit per reduced graph, seed0, 300 epochs, hidden256, validation selection every10; outside timing/memory; descriptive quality shortfall retained
